criteria.statement: .github/workflows/quality-check.yml has a workflow_dispatch trigger in addition to the existing push/pull_request triggers
the deploy job's precondition additionally requires the change-detection step's code-set verdict (or workflow_dispatch); an all-non-code-set push does not run deploy
static, backend, frontend, and coverage-merge keep their current trigger conditions; no paths/paths-ignore key is added at the workflow's top-level on: block
the change-detection step's logic defaults to deploy when the changed-file set can't be determined (first push / all-zeros base SHA)
the change-detection step writes the paths it evaluated and its deploy/skip decision to the job log, not just a silent job-level if:
npm run format:check passes (the edited workflow YAML parses and is formatted)
A dated manual observation records a line-by-line read of the final deploy: job block confirming the code-set path list, the composed if: condition, and that no code-set path was dropped
